title: Use Cordyceps programmatically outside Playwright
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can wire a real AI harness to Cordyceps programmatically outside Playwright so that I can run specific experiments and tests or build my own mocking framework.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A consumer program can configure a supported, already-installed real harness to use the mock provider without running Playwright or using its fixtures.
The programmatic API exposes process input and requests received by the mock provider outside Playwright.
The consumer program can intercept provider requests and prescribe text or supported tool-call responses outside Playwright; the real binary retains its normal tool execution behavior.
A consumer can invoke the setup, observation, and response-control APIs from its own experiment, test, or mocking framework without adopting the Playwright test lifecycle.
